import numpy as np
from scipy.interpolate import make_splrep

x = np.array([20.00, 153.81, 175.57, 202.47, 237.11, 253.61, 258.56, 273.40,
              284.54, 293.61, 298.56, 301.86, 305.57, 307.22, 308.45, 310.10,
              310.10, 310.50])
y = np.array([53.00, 49.50, 48.60, 46.80, 43.20, 40.32, 39.60, 36.00, 32.40,
              28.80, 25.20, 21.60, 18.00, 14.40, 10.80, 7.20, 3.60, 0.0])
w = np.full(18, 1.38723)

raised_valueerror = 0.0
other_error = 0.0
n_coeffs = -1.0
n_nan = -1.0
coeff_0 = 0.0
coeff_last = 0.0

try:
    spl = make_splrep(x, y, w=w, k=2, s=12)
    c = np.asarray(spl.c, dtype=float)
    n_coeffs = float(c.size)
    n_nan = float(np.count_nonzero(~np.isfinite(c)))
    if c.size:
        coeff_0 = float(c[0])
        coeff_last = float(c[-1])
except ValueError:
    raised_valueerror = 1.0
except Exception:
    other_error = 1.0

probe("raised_valueerror", raised_valueerror)
probe("other_error", other_error)
probe("n_coeffs", n_coeffs)
probe("n_nan_coeffs", n_nan)
probe("coeff_0", coeff_0)
probe("coeff_last", coeff_last)
